summary: AegisGraph turns uploaded documents, KEV catalogs and scanner reports into cited workspace evidence. Local SQLite works without accounts; Neon and the optional Neo4j projection await live connection checks. LangGraph organizes a deterministic read-only investigation. Real AI models and automatic remediation are not implemented.

diagrams.title: System architecture
diagrams.description: FastAPI enforces workspace roles. SQLite or Neon stores extraction batches, topics and request audit events. Queries traverse the embedded graph; Neo4j is an optional derived copy, not the active query engine.

diagrams.title: Scanner report and source flow
diagrams.description: Trivy vulnerability JSON, OSV JSON and SARIF 2.1.0 are accepted through file upload. SARIF supports located CodeQL/Semgrep results. Selected fields become quoted observations; raw snippets and network requests are omitted. Secret-scanner SARIF is rejected. No scanner is executed by the import endpoint.

diagrams.title: LangGraph investigation workflow
diagrams.description: The installed LangGraph engine runs three deterministic nodes for each request. It uses existing cited retrieval and path traversal. Review is advisory: no scanner, shell or remediation command is available. Durable multi-turn agent sessions and model-driven decisions are future work.

nodes.label: CVE or entity selected by analyst

diagrams.title: Document lifecycle and restart recovery
diagrams.description: Sources and atomic operation checkpoints stay on disk. Completed batches, themes and audit metadata persist in SQLite/Neon. Restart reconstructs the graph and resumes nonterminal jobs whose source files remain available. Hosted disks/object storage still need configuration.

diagrams.title: Repository security and runtime boundaries
diagrams.description: GitHub workflows are configured for Semgrep rules, redacted Gitleaks history scans and CodeQL analysis. Gitleaks ran locally with no leaks; Semgrep local execution is blocked by its Windows socket error. CI results must be checked after push. Runtime controls enforce roles, upload limits, per-process rate limits and metadata-only audits.

nodes.label: Semgrep code rules in Linux CI

diagrams.title: Connection and integration boundaries
diagrams.description: Report imports and local investigations work without scanner accounts or model keys. ZAP and Nuclei have not been integrated or run. Any future active scanning needs explicit authorized targets. Cloud connections, real models and direct Neo4j traversal remain separate work.
